environment.description: Terraform provider REST API backend deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS passthrough. No application-layer inspection. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same VPC with tf_resources table containing sensitive state data. Security groups allow inbound 8443 from VPC CIDR. The provider API is called by Terraform Cloud workspace runners during plan/apply phases.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB with TLS passthrough (no inspection)
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4, same VPC, no query-level audit
config.iam: EC2 instance role with rds-data:* permissions
